original_test_intent: Validate Type 40's entry count n by proving exactly n complete variable-length Additional Information entries fit the declared formatted-section length and remain structurally stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 40, validate minimum/declared length, read n, walk exactly n entry-length-delimited records without overlap/truncation/overflow, account for remaining bytes under policy and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves parser/policies and reboot; all core count/boundary validation is deterministic and read-only.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS Type 40 layout/version and raw access path
Policy for n=0, multiple Type 40 structures and legal trailing/padding bytes
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not repair or write firmware tables.
Bounds-check the formatted section before every entry-length read.
Preserve raw bytes and stop parsing on zero/short/overflowing length rather than resynchronizing by guess.
Do not auto-retry reboot; stop on recovery failure.
agent_execution_scope: Parse n and every entry offset/length, prove exact count/bounds/accounting, preserve raw evidence and compare the structural map across reboot.
Report malformed counts/boundaries or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve multiple-record/trailing-byte and n=0 policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret any vendor-defined padding exception and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is related, but grep cannot prove the count matches complete variable-length entries or the declared record boundary.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 40 and emit handle/declared length/n plus entry index, offset, length, end offset and final byte-accounting result before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 40 count scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no table mutation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a raw length-aware parser to walk exactly n entries, validate each length and final boundary, and compare the resulting entry map across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 40 Additional Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, decoder/dmidecode and raw-access versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 40 header, Number of Additional Information Entries and variable-entry layout definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces displayed count grep with a proof that n and physical entry layout agree.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncation, overlap, zero-length loops, overflow and hidden/unconsumed formatted bytes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Formatted decoders may omit malformed trailing data; raw bytes are required for complete structural evidence.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define acceptable multiple-record or documented padding behavior, but cannot waive boundary safety or count-to-entry consistency.
expected_evidence: Complete pre-reboot raw Type 40 handles/declared lengths and n values
Per-entry offset/length/end table and final boundary/accounting result
Parser diagnostics showing no guessed resynchronization
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot structural diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The count is a defined Type 40 field; its correctness necessarily includes the variable-entry layout it governs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw structural parsing is fully automatable; missing parser/reboot policy affects readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw length, per-entry boundary and final byte-accounting validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its structural method while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates parser/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Turns a self-reported count into a bounded proof over every variable-length entry, exposing malformed records that a formatter may hide.
independent_technical_reasoning: A count byte is valid only if it can drive a total, non-overlapping walk of the declared formatted area; the count and entry-length chain are one structural invariant.
